stories.title: Paonia welcomes author Peter Heller home with sold-out screening of 'The Dog Stars'
stories.summary: Author Peter Heller joined a sold-out Paonia screening of “The Dog Stars,” the Ridley Scott film inspired by his novel set partly in the Colorado town.

stories.title: 'Gategate': Bow Mar hits 'hard pause' on gate construction following Denver, Littleton lawsuit
stories.summary: A town spokesperson told 9NEWS on Tuesday that the town is pausing its planned construction date because of the lawsuit.

stories.title: Man sentenced for fatal crash involving school bus carrying high school wrestling team
stories.summary: The crash killed 18-year-old Julio Vasquez-Gonzalez, and injured everyone on the school bus and passengers in Andrew Miller's SUV.

stories.title: Denver Fire Weather Watch Wednesday ahead of mountain storm and snow
stories.summary: Approaching storm to bring high winds and light mountain snow. The National Weather Service issues a High Wind Warning for the Front Range Mountains and Foothills.

stories.title: Denver ticketed Waymo once, city says it can't do much else
stories.summary: Ahead of a city council committee briefing Wednesday, city agencies said one unpaid parking citation is the only ticket issued to a Waymo in Denver.

stories.title: District attorney releases timeline of events and justifies officer's use of force in CSU shooting
stories.summary: A judge has ordered Brooks Bottenhorn, 22, to stay away from campus. He's also prohibited from possessing weapons, drugs or alcohol and was released on bond.

stories.title: Southwest Colorado flood victims face housing uncertainty as temporary housing assistance set to expire
stories.summary: More than 400 households received temporary housing assistance after October flooding, but some families have nowhere to go when their up to 28-day stays end.

stories.title: Cybersecurity experts share thoughts on recent outages and service issues
stories.summary: After a week of widespread problems affecting online services, questions are swirling about causes, mitigation and prevention, especially as AI continues to advance.

stories.title: Prep Rally Honor Roll (11/17/26) | VOTE NOW
stories.summary: Watch the best Colorado high school sports moments of the week and vote for your favorite in the 9NEWS Prep Rally Honor Roll.

stories.title: Woman told Denver Police she feared her grown son. Now she's dead and he's suspected of murder
stories.summary: Officers took no action after concluding the man wasn't a threat to himself or others and not a candidate for a mental health hold.

stories.title: Man convicted, sentenced for murdering man and lighting his body on fire
stories.summary: Gerardo Hernandez-Lucio was shot and killed in LaSalle. Days later, his body was set on fire under a bridge near Stevens Gulch Picnic Site.

stories.title: Wolf brought to Colorado from Canada dies in Utah
stories.summary: Colorado Parks said the female gray wolf traveled 9,000 miles on her own across Colorado and into neighboring states over 18 months.
